✅  EASY INSTALLATION - JUST DOUBLE-CLICK!

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📋 INSTALLATION STEPS:

1. Find the file "install.command" in this folder

2. Double-click "install.command"
   └─ Terminal will open automatically
   └─ No commands to type!

3. Follow the on-screen instructions
   └─ That's it!

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✨ It's that simple!

The installer does everything automatically.
You don't need to type any Terminal commands.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📖 For detailed instructions, see:
   • INSTALLATION_GUIDE.md
   • QUICK_START.md
